english.title: Fail to notify Board of Trade / other competent authority of undertaking required to make return
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person carrying on an undertaking of a class or description published in

(A)_[the Gazette,]_
(B)_[the Gazette and **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR NEWSPAPERS..),]_

namely **(..SPECIFY CLASS OR DESCRIPTION..), in relation to which returns were required for the purpose of a census under the Statistics of Trade Act 1947, and who had not received a notice under section 3(2) of the Act, failed within **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), being the specified period, to

(C)_[inform **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person specified in the advertisement that you were carrying on such an undertaking as aforesaid]_
(D)_[give to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person specified in the advertisement the prescribed particulars of the undertaking as specified therein, namely **(..SPECIFY PRESCRIBED PARTICULARS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(3) of the Statistics of Trade Act 1947.
